ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast with approximately 60% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels and 40% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blocks occupy the lateral two-thirds of both the left and right lobes. These are bisected by a dark, low-intensity median column extending from the peduncle. The white regions are overlaid with high-contrast, non-contiguous dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 45-55 degrees; notch depth is distinct and well-defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes visible along the entire length of the trailing edge, reaching maximum prominence and depth near the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, upturned lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark-ringed circular scars with light centers located in the lower-medial region of the left lobe and the lower-central region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant density of dark vertical and diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation on both lobes, particularly prominent on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized cluster of white, calcified organisms (barnacles) present on the superior-most edge of the left fluke lobe tip.
